name: complicated
quote: Do you want the short answer or the long one?
description: A perception that understanding or resolving a situation will involve many careful and possibly difficult steps.
perceptions: There's a lot to know about this topic.
There are many things that are related to each other in various ways.
results: You may be challenged by learning something complicated, which may become a source of pride or frustration depending on the outcome.

variations.name: technical
variations.description: The tense that a topic is complicated but involves only machines or math rather than people.
perceptions: There's a lot to know about this topic.
There are many things that are related to each other in various ways.
At least people and their slippery behavior aren't part of the challenge.
results: You may be challenged by learning something complicated, which may become a source of pride or frustration depending on the outcome.

comparisons.description: 'Technical' is a specific type of 'complicated' where people problems aren't the focus.

guidance.description: The specifics of resolving technical problems varies across fields, but there are some general outlooks held by engineers and technicians.

commentaries.quote: All you really need to know for the moment is that the universe is a lot more complicated than you might think, even if you start from a position of thinking it's pretty damn complicated in the first place.
Some things in life are too complicated to explain in any language.
I’ve yet to see any problem, however complicated, which when you looked at it the right way didn’t become still more complicated.
Can we go back to the way things were, before life got so complicated with the wheel and then the three other wheels?
You will only be remembered for two things: the problems you solve or the ones you create.
The problem is not the problem, it’s your attitude about the problem.
